title: 30M Cell Granularity Screening under Local Plasticity
purpose: mechanism screening before the longer Experiment 026 confirmation run

arms.local_plasticity_rule: same normalized local gradient-pressure rule used by Experiment 026

interpretation_limits: 026a is a screening experiment, not a confirmatory result.
A positive gate means the mechanism is worth spending the larger Experiment 026 budget on; it is not itself evidence of autonomous mitosis.
A negative gate should trigger architecture/plasticity diagnostics before increasing token budget.
The synthetic domains are controlled environments, not broad capability benchmarks.
